lines: hook
Unpopular opinion: sometimes, the fake is the smarter buy.
price
Most of a luxury price isn't the product. It's the logo, the ads, and the fancy store.
copy
Take that away, and a good copy can look almost identical, for a fraction of the cost.
same
Same shape. Same colour. Same everyday use.
notice
And honestly, most people won't notice. Walk past a hundred strangers, and nobody is checking the stitching.
trend
Trends also change fast. Why spend a month's rent on something you'll stop wearing next season?
worry
A cheaper bag also takes the pressure off. Scuff it, spill on it, leave it on the bus. It's not a disaster.
save
The money you save could buy five styles, instead of one.
grow
Or skip the extra bags, and put that money somewhere it can actually grow.
addup
Even small savings add up over time.
status
Because real status isn't a logo on your arm. It's knowing you didn't overpay for one.
end
So before you pay for the name, ask yourself: are you buying the product, or the label?
